findings.title: Missing-address validation silently deletes the allergy note
findings.expected: Keep the exact allergy note through coupon correction, rejected submission, address correction and the final order.
findings.observed: The note remains after both coupon attempts. Clicking 48,000원 결제하기 with an empty detail address clears the note to 0/50. Entering 302동1104호 and submitting produces 가게 요청 없음. Reproduced at 384x832, 320x568 and 1440x900. Other selected values and 48,000원 remain correct.
steps: Choose 반반치킨 (후라이드+양념), 순살, 콜라 1.25L; omit sauce and attempt add, then select 매운 양념 and add.
Increase cart quantity to 2 and proceed.
Enter 땅콩 알레르기가 있어요. 양념에 땅콩가루 빼 주세요 and select 문 앞에 두고 벨 눌러주세요.
Try HANKI5000, correct to HANKKI5000, and select 동네페이.
Submit without detail address; then enter 302동1104호 and submit without re-entering the note.
Inspect 가게 요청 in the final summary.
findings.limits: Final rendered values only; no server payload inspected. Re-entering the note after the failed submit and corrected address preserves it in a separately tested order. Implementation cause unknown; the loss is isolated to the rejected-submit transition.

findings.title: The required chicken-part choice cannot be selected with the keyboard
findings.expected: A keyboard user can reach and choose 순살 and complete the same required selections.
findings.observed: Tab traversal skips both 뼈 and 순살 and moves from the back control/heading into sauce and extras. 순살 is exposed as plain text, with no focusable control or selection role; the inspected element has tabIndex -1. Pointer selection works, but the required choice blocks a keyboard-only order.
steps: Open the target product in a fresh state at 1440x900.
Use Tab through the option screen for a complete focus cycle.
Observe that sauce radios, extras and add are reachable, but neither chicken-part option is reachable.
Compare with A: Tab and ArrowRight select boneless, Tab and ArrowRight select spicy sauce, then Tab to cola and Space select it.
findings.limits: Keyboard focus and accessible DOM were checked in Chromium. No screen reader or voice control was used. The rest of B’s flow was exercised with pointer/DOM-targeted input; no keyboard-only completion is claimed.

findings.title: Mobile sauce buttons clip the surcharge text
findings.expected: Read the complete sauce name and surcharge before selecting it at both mobile widths.
findings.observed: At 384px the right side of 매운 양념 +500원 and 간장마늘 +1,000원 is clipped. At 320px the clipping removes more of both prices. The labels fit at 1440px. Scrolling vertically and selecting the sauce did not reveal the complete price in the option button.
steps: Open 반반치킨 (후라이드+양념) at 384x832 and scroll to 소스 선택.
Inspect all three sauce labels.
Repeat at 320x568, including the selected spicy-sauce state.
findings.limits: Confirmed from screenshots, not rectangle intersections. Full names exist in the accessible DOM and the selected surcharge is readable later in the cart. Figma fidelity is unknown.

findings.title: Adding without sauce gives no visible explanation
findings.expected: A rejected add explains that a required sauce is missing and allows recovery without losing existing selections.
findings.observed: With boneless and cola selected and sauce omitted, clicking 24,500원 담기 leaves the user on the option screen. No error text, required-group highlight or recovery instruction appears in the screenshot or accessible tree. Selecting spicy sauce then adds a correct 25,000원 item. A provides 소스를 1개 선택해 주세요 and a visible group outline for the same omission.
steps: Choose 순살 and 콜라 1.25L without choosing sauce.
Press 담기.
Inspect the option screen and accessible tree for a specific error.
Choose 매운 양념 and add successfully.
findings.limits: Reproduced at both mobile sizes. Desktop omission was not separately exercised. No claim is made about fleeting feedback outside the captured state.

findings.title: The typo-coupon error provides only an internal error code
findings.expected: For a nonexistent coupon, explain the input problem and offer an actionable correction.
findings.observed: HANKI5000 yields 쿠폰을 적용할 수 없습니다. (CPN-4003), without indicating the spelling problem. The code stays editable and HANKKI5000 successfully applies a 5,000원 discount. The observed problem is limited recovery guidance, not a broken coupon calculation.
steps: At checkout enter HANKI5000 and click 적용.
Read the error at each requested viewport.
Replace it with HANKKI5000 and apply; verify 48,000원 total.
findings.limits: No measured user-confusion or prevalence claim. Correcting the coupon was possible and retained the note before the separate address-error transition.

findings.title: Cart quantity buttons have no accessible names
findings.expected: The plus and minus controls expose their quantity-adjustment action to assistive technology.
findings.observed: The cart shows visible minus and plus icons, but its accessible tree exposes an unnamed disabled button at quantity 1 and an unnamed enabled button. The controls have no accessible names. Pointer activation of plus correctly changes quantity to 2 and total to 50,000원.
steps: Add the configured item and open the cart.
Inspect the accessible names of the two buttons around the quantity.
Activate the visible plus button and verify quantity and total.
findings.limits: Accessible names and visible behavior observed; actual screen-reader output was not tested. Repeated viewport occurrences are one issue family.

findings.title: The detail-address error is not associated with its field
findings.expected: When detail address is rejected, expose the error relationship and invalid state programmatically along with the visible message.
findings.observed: The red field and detail-address message are visible, but #addr-detail has neither aria-invalid nor aria-describedby after the failed submit. The field is not focused. A exposes aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby=addr-detail-error. Missing automatic focus is an observation; the finding is the absent programmatic error association.
steps: Reach checkout with the configured item, quantity 2 and valid coupon.
Leave detail address empty and click 48,000원 결제하기.
Inspect the visible message and input error semantics.
findings.limits: No screen-reader announcement test or formal KWCAG/WCAG conformance verdict. Native focus behavior alone is not classified as a defect.

limitations: Single operator; no delegation or independent review. High-severity findings received a labelled self-review of capture and text evidence.
Owned headless Chromium, CSS viewports at DPR 1; no real-device keyboard, safe-area, Safari/WebKit, screen reader, voice control or OS-level assistive technology tests.
200% text resize, text-spacing overrides, contrast measurement and exhaustive focus checks were not run.
No product source, repository reports, keys, memory or prior sessions read; no product modification, installation, external site or real payment.
Final values verified in rendered UI, not network payload or server storage. Build identity supplied by the task, not independently checked.
Only requested key states and bounded recovery paths audited. No all-QA-pass or product readiness claim.
Desktop required-sauce omission, history/back persistence and reload persistence were not separately tested.
